sources.heading: Alpha and Beta
sources.text:
# Alpha and Beta
Alpha depends on Beta. Beta is a durable queue. ADR-17 chose Beta because message replay is required. Incident INC-12 affected Alpha and was resolved by enabling idempotent consumers. Alpha depends on Gateway for authentication.

sources.heading: Alpha observability
sources.text:
# Alpha observability
Alpha uses Datadog APM. Incident INC-9 affected Alpha: traces were missing because DD_SERVICE was incorrect. INC-9 was resolved by setting DD_SERVICE to alpha-api. The rollout dashboard checks error rate and p95 latency. Alpha publishes queue lag for Beta.

sources.heading: Gateway authentication
sources.text:
# Gateway authentication
Gateway validates tokens using introspection. ADR-21 chose introspection because immediate revocation is required. Alpha depends on Gateway. Gateway degradation blocks the Alpha rollout. Gateway has a runbook RB-8 that checks introspection latency before retrying.

Migration M1 affects Alpha. M1 deploys with GitLab CI and Helm. Rollback uses the previous immutable image digest. M1 requires a healthy Alpha dashboard before rollout. Security gate SEC-4 requires zero high vulnerabilities before release.

sources.heading: Gateway authentication
sources.text:
# Gateway authentication
Gateway validates tokens using introspection. ADR-21 chose introspection because immediate revocation is required. Alpha depends on Gateway. Gateway degradation blocks the Alpha rollout. Gateway has a runbook RB-8 that checks introspection latency before retrying.

sources.heading: Alpha and Beta
sources.text:
# Alpha and Beta
Alpha depends on Beta. Beta is a durable queue. ADR-17 chose Beta because message replay is required. Incident INC-12 affected Alpha and was resolved by enabling idempotent consumers. Alpha depends on Gateway for authentication.

sources.heading: Alpha observability
sources.text:
# Alpha observability
Alpha uses Datadog APM. Incident INC-9 affected Alpha: traces were missing because DD_SERVICE was incorrect. INC-9 was resolved by setting DD_SERVICE to alpha-api. The rollout dashboard checks error rate and p95 latency. Alpha publishes queue lag for Beta.
